title: Write a one-level flatten function
prompt: Write a Python function `flatten(nested)` that takes a list which may contain nested lists (only one level deep) and returns a single flattened list.

metadata.notes: Correct: e.g. flatten([1, [2, 3], 4]) == [1, 2, 3, 4]; only needs to handle one level of nesting per the spec. No sandboxed execution yet; graded manually.
